outputs.explanation: This is a schematic-style bar/timeline diagram showing calculated illumination-overhead percentages for each exposure setting; these are single deterministic values (not averages across replicate experiments), so individual data points are not applicable.
Line plot of photobleaching decay curves with shaded mean±s.e.m.; line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual data points.
XY scatter plot of ΔROS vs exposure time with error bars and a fitted curve; scatter-type plots are exempt from the individual-points requirement.
Each panel displays raw individual cell-migration tracks (not an averaged summary), so individual data are already fully shown.
Bar chart of migration speed (mean±s.e.m.) has individual cell data points overlaid as black dots on each bar.
Panel F consists of fluorescence micrographs (MitoTracker, paxillin, merge), not a plot of averaged data.
Panel G is a time-lapse micrograph series, not a plot.
Panel H is a time-lapse micrograph series, not a plot.
Line plot of normalized cell area over time (mean±s.e.m., n=5); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
Line plot of normalized mitochondrial area over time (mean±s.e.m., n=5); line plots are exempt from requiring overlaid individual points.
